title: Falcon (X4: Foundations)
intro: The Falcon is a small Teladi fighter with two forward guns and strong shields for its size. It uses the shared X4 flight controls.

panels.name: Falcon: seat and weapons
panels.text: Facts about the Falcon that set it apart from other X4 ships: where the pilot sits and which guns, turrets and docking it has.
panels.context: All other controls of the Falcon are the shared X4 controls of this guide.

controls.name: Pilot seat
controls.text: The Falcon is flown from a cockpit seat, as small and medium ships are. The pilot sits here and has all the controls of this guide.
controls.context: From this seat the pilot sees the HUD, the radar and the monitors of the Falcon.

controls.name: Forward guns
controls.text: The Falcon has two forward guns that point where the nose points. The pilot fires them with the trigger and aims by turning the whole ship.
controls.context: The aiming mark in front of the target on the HUD shows where to point the nose.

controls.name: Shields
controls.text: The Falcon has strong shields for a ship of its size, an energy layer that takes hits before the hull does.
controls.context: Strong shields let the pilot stay in a fight longer; they recharge after a while without hits.
